description: The Center for Internet Security (CIS) publishes this benchmark as a tool to improve the security configuration of Windows 11 devices managed by Microsoft Intune. The recommendations are based on the CIS Windows 11 Benchmark and settings available through Intune configuration profiles. Questions, comments, or proposed improvements to this benchmark should be sent to benchmarkinfo@cisecurity.org.
displayName: CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark (Audit Only) (Preview)
